ui_save.meaning: Generic saving/persisting command, deliberately not image-only: File menu and quick icon reuse saved destination/options or open initial PNG Save as panel; palette replacement commits chosen colour into CustomColours preferences; credits editor saves current credit edits and remains open. No claim of success before validation/I/O.
complete_context: ClassicPaintActivity.kt: requestSave, showSaveOptions, chooseSaveLocation, writeImage, ioFailed, addColour, showImageCredits
ActionButton.kt: EditIcon.SAVE, init contentDescription and tooltip
AdvancedColourDialog.kt: show positive callback and dismiss logic
GalleryCredits.kt: buildEditor save and neutral button override
CreditEditSession.kt and ImageCreditArchive.kt: actual callback persistence
ui_save.qualification: Save label must not mean Download/Export/Close or only save image. Image Save applies pending canvas work; successful non-export updates remembered destination and document saved state. Credit Save does not close the editor; palette Save also selects colour.

ui_save_a5d0d9.meaning: Positive Save… in confirmReplacement, before replacing dirty image. Stores requested continuation then requestSave(false); successful non-export write invokes it. Cancellation/failure clears continuation. Existing saved target can be written without another dialog; ellipsis is retained from English, not a promise every invocation opens one.
complete_context: ClassicPaintActivity.kt: confirmReplacement, requestSave, launchPicker, onActivityResult, writeImage, ioFailed
ui_save_a5d0d9.qualification: Not immediate discard or replacement, not an unconditional success claim; unchanged source ellipsis not a proven defect.

save20_title.meaning: File menu Save as… command and ordinary save-options dialog title. Opens format/name/settings form then Android create-document location picker; not immediate saving. A successful ordinary save replaces remembered save destination/settings.
complete_context: ClassicPaintActivity.kt: file menu, showSaveOptions, chooseSaveLocation, writeImage
save20_title.qualification: Not rename-only, not Save a copy with unchanged destination, not Export as. Excludes share/export titles and complex explanations.

save20_file_name.meaning: Visible filename field label and its contentDescription, reused in horizontal and vertical forms. Editable basename with format extension: known extension replaced/appended on format change; validation forbids slashes/control characters and invalid blank/dot stems. Proposed name sent to Android document picker.
complete_context: SaveOptionsDialog.kt: ExportNames.withExtension/valid, show filename, update spinner, vertical field, confirm
save20_file_name.qualification: File name, not full path/location; label does not translate typed user filenames or extensions. Same label is shared by save/export/share panels.

save20_file_format.meaning: Visible format chooser label and contentDescription, reused in vertical form. Selects encoded output format and associated settings; ordinary save excludes derived formats, export filters derived formats, share can show all. Changes filename extension and applicable controls.
complete_context: SaveOptionsDialog.kt: ImageFormat, show format filter and Spinner update; ExportNames
save20_file_format.qualification: Format/type of output file, not page layout, style, format-device action or filename extension alone. Format names and compression descriptions not translated in this group.

limits: No production edits or translation acceptance.
Prior 72 ready and 12 held keys excluded.
